title: The build order in five stages
desc: Stage 0, experiments: you know the design holds. Stage 1, the lock: you protect a change by hand. Stage 2, the loop: Tollgate builds one ticket. Stage 3, the task: you give a task and read a report. Stage 4, scale: large requests and many projects.
